images.notes: WordPress uses filename suffixes for responsive: -300x200.jpg, -1024x683.jpg, -scaled.jpg. Photon CDN uses ?w=&h= query params. Photon transparently converts to WebP (extension unchanged, Content-Type differs).

quirks.description: WordPress generates responsive variants as filename suffixes: -WxH (e.g., image-1024x768.jpg) and -scaled (for uploads >2560px). Core sizes: 150x150, 300, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048.
quirks.workaround: Strip suffix with regex /-(\d+x\d+|scaled)(?=\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|avif)$)/i to find original.

quirks.description: Sites with Jetpack rewrite image URLs to i0-i3.wp.com CDN with ?w=, ?h=, ?quality=, ?zoom= params. Photon silently converts to WebP (URL extension stays .jpg but Content-Type is image/webp).
quirks.workaround: Match i[0-3].wp.com pattern. Strip Photon domain and params to recover original path. Check Content-Type header for actual format.

quirks.description: Various lazy-load plugins move src to data-src, data-lazy-src, data-lazy-srcset, data-lazy-sizes. Some use lazyload CSS class (lazysizes.js) or data-bg for background images.
quirks.workaround: Check data-src, data-lazy-src, data-lazy-srcset, data-original, and data-bg attributes. Also check noscript siblings for original img tags.

quirks.description: WordPress 5.3+ generates -scaled.{ext} when uploads exceed 2560px. The original is preserved but not served. The -scaled suffix must be handled alongside -WxH suffixes.
quirks.workaround: Include -scaled in the suffix-stripping regex alongside -WxH pattern.

quirks.description: WordPress 6.3+ adds fetchpriority='high' to the LCP image and omits loading='lazy'. These attributes are mutually exclusive.
quirks.workaround: Preserve fetchpriority='high' on the first content image in the migration. Do not add loading='lazy' to it.

quirks.description: The Modern Image Formats plugin wraps in with and .
quirks.workaround: Handle elements and extract highest-quality source (typically the original JPEG/PNG from the fallback).
